request: Atlanta on Friday, December 4, for the extension directors' meeting. Please put me on Delta: I'm chasing Diamond Medallion status this year and this trip would get me there, even if it's a bit more than the others.

must_keep.quote: However, if an employee makes travel arrangements which favor a preferred airline/supplier to receive reward/points and this circumvents purchasing the most economical means of travel, the employee is in violation of this travel policy. Costs for travel arrangements subject to this violation are non-reimbursable.
must_keep.why: routing for points over the most economical fare is a violation

must_keep.quote: Commercial air travel will not be reimbursed more than lowest logical coach/economy class rates when it has been determined to be the best value. The difference between coach/economy class rates and first class or business class rates will be paid by the traveler.
must_keep.why: the University pays the lowest logical coach fare; the traveller pays any difference

must_keep.quote: The lowest logical airfare is the cheapest available at the time of booking without causing undo inconvenience. These types of airfares are non-refundable, penalty tickets.
must_keep.why: definition P: the lowest logical airfare, non-refundable

distractors.quote: Employees may retain hotel reward/points and frequent flyer miles earned on official University travel
distractors.why: keeping miles is allowed; choosing a dearer airline to earn them is not

design_notes: Elite status is the "reward/points" of lines 440-444: favouring Delta for it, 4200 cents above the lowest logical fare, breaks the policy, and those costs are non-reimbursable. Book the United fare.
